chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever grows a gray hair in Islam, it will be a light for him on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: the state of being within Islam and living as a Muslim
key_terms.شَيْبَةً: a gray hair or sign of old age
key_terms.نُورًا: light, meaning a source of illumination and honor in the Hereafter
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when people are raised and judged

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for growing old in Islam according to this hadith?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that aging while remaining within Islam carries spiritual merit. Even a sign of old age, such as a gray hair, becomes a source of light on the Day of Judgment, pointing to the honor of lifelong faith and steadfastness.
